title: EnvOpt: Automated Optimization for Agent Environments
abstract: arXiv:2611.07372v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An LLM agent's cost and success depend on its model, its harness, and its environment. In addition to the widely studied directions of parameter tuning and harness optimization, we propose the third direction: optimization over stationary environments. Agents are often deployed in rich environments shared by many tasks, such as a company's Slack workspace or a complex collection of data sources, documents or tickets. We call these environments stationary environments. We introduce EnvOpt, a method for automated end-to-end optimization of stationary environments for any given model and harness, using real or synthetic tasks without needing any graders or reference answers. On AutomationBench, EnvOpt reduces the cost of Claude Haiku 4.5 by 72.7% and raises its pass rate by 14.34%. The same environment transfers to Opus 5, cutting its cost by 68.1% with a 1.34% gain. translated_title: EnvOpt：面向智能体环境的自动化优化
translated_abstract: 一个LLM智能体的成本与成功取决于其模型、执行框架及其环境。除了被广泛研究的参数调优和执行框架优化方向之外，我们提出了第三个方向：对静态环境的优化。智能体通常部署在由众多任务共享的丰富环境中，例如公司的Slack工作区，或由数据源、文档、工单组成的复杂集合。我们将这类环境称为静态环境。我们提出了EnvOpt，一种针对任意给定模型和执行框架的静态环境自动化端到端优化方法，它可以使用真实或合成任务，且无需任何评分器或参考答案。在AutomationBench上，EnvOpt将Claude Haiku 4.5的成本降低了72.7%，同时将其通过率提高了14.34%。相同的环境可迁移至Opus 5，将其成本降低68.1%，并带来1.34%的提升。在Meta-Harness针对Haiku 4.5优化的执行框架之上叠加使用时，它可进一步降低（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: EnvOpt提出了对LLM智能体静态环境进行自动化端到端优化的第三条路径，无需评分器或参考答案即可大幅降低智能体成本（最高72.7%）并提升任务通过率。
en_tdlr: EnvOpt introduces automated end-to-end optimization of stationary agent environments—a third optimization direction beyond parameter tuning and harness optimization—cutting costs by up to 72.7% and boosting pass rates without requiring graders or reference answers.
